scope: Four construction-only 165x159 carrier initial-ordering experiments; no production heuristic retained and no full qualification performed.
common: Same explicit order 3, compact geometry, edge feasibility, board_aux=owned-face-fixed/a2.2/owned-pins-forward, owned quality/face cohesion and USB-JTAG contract-group candidates as the failed-first candidate; failed-first recovery disabled. Exact placement checks and execution accounting remained active.

variants.name: Static feasible nearest-shape offers
variants.ranking: Stable ascending distinct (x,y,w,h,primary side) nearest-shape offers before interior placement.

variants.name: Static physical-domain sample count
variants.ranking: Union of feasible (x,y,primary face mask) grid samples over allowed variants, with current near_max necessary windows and hashed physical occupancy. Sample pitch 4*occ_step = 4 mm.

variants.name: Dynamic physical-domain sample count
variants.ranking: Recompute the same sampled domains for remaining blocks after each actual placement; stable least-domain-first ordering.
variants.result: Constructed but rejected for poorer estimate/headroom and greater fallback use; not an accepted board.

variants.name: Dynamic area-normalized physical domain
variants.ranking: Compare sampled position count divided by minimum offered primary-box area, via cross multiplication.
variants.result: hdmi_rx_term then usb_pd interior seating failures in the two outer attempts

limits: Coarse domain counts were ordering heuristics, not feasibility proofs; zero samples did not waive/reject physical acceptance by themselves. Unshaped pseudo-blocks used a prototype placeholder rank. Quantization work from occupancy probes was recorded. No reproducibility campaign or full-board audit/render run for these rejected screens. Fixed-outline proxy budget is not a measured routed-length or independent final LAW-5 verdict.
decision: All prototype edits, including diagnostic prints, removed. Shape-option counts are not a reliable measure of remaining spatial freedom; dynamic occupancy helps seating but not necessarily wiring quality, legality repair effort or runtime. Do not repeat these unchanged heuristics or adopt their candidate solely because it seats.
